name: Victoria University of Wellington
description: Victoria University of Wellington (Te Herenga Waka) is a public research university in Wellington, New Zealand's capital, founded in 1897 as Victoria College. Its faculties span law, humanities, science, engineering and business.
whyIncluded: Its LLB is one of only two New Zealand law degrees on the Singapore Institute of Legal Education's list of approved overseas universities (graduates in the top 70% of their cohort), and New Zealand is among the ten destinations with the most Singaporean students abroad (about 360, UNESCO data for 2022-24).

livingCosts.summary: The university's example budget for a student in a catered hall of residence over 40 weeks: room with meals and utilities, transport and personal spending. Excludes textbooks, insurance, visa and airfares.
livingCosts.notes: Victoria University of Wellington 'Money Matters 2026' example budget for a student in a hall of residence, 40 weeks at the 2026 rate, weekly x 52/12. Housing: catered room $578/wk (electricity, internet and meals included), so food is 0 because it is inside the room rate. Transport: $10/wk. Personal: mobile phone $15 + toiletries $15 + personal spending $70/wk. The example's weekly total is $688 ($27,520 for 40 weeks); excludes occasional costs (holiday travel, laptop, textbooks), insurance, visa and airfare. The guide's overall estimate is $20,000-$33,000 for 40 weeks.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science (Computer Science)
programmes.feeBasis: The BSc in Computer Science at Victoria's 2027 undergraduate science rate, NZ$357.43 per point x 120 points = NZ$42,892 a year (computing courses are in the science group).
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition for international students for an average full-time year in 2027, including GST. Student services and hardship fees included; insurance is extra. Fees reviewed yearly.
programmes.notes: 2027 international undergraduate Science rate $357.43 per point x 120 points (the university's 'average year of full-time study'); COMP courses are in the Science fee band (Fees Schedule 2027). 360 points = 3 years. Compulsory = 2027 Student Services Fee $10.64/point x 120 ($1,276.80) + Student Hardship Fee $33 (wgtn.ac.nz/students/money/fees/student-services-fee). 2026 = 2026 Science rate $337.20 x 120 with SSF $10.44 x 120 + $32. 2025 = Fees Schedule 2025, Part B, Science band 6, COMP (100-300 level) $318.12 x 120 with Part C SSF $9.94 x 120 + $32 hardship fee; 2024 = Fees Schedule 2024, Part B, Science band 6, COMP (100-300 level) $302.97 x 120 with Part C SSF $9.20 x 120 + $30 hardship fee (University Calendar PDFs, wgtn.ac.nz/about/governance/university-publications/calendar; all international rates include GST). Excludes insurance. Fees reviewed annually.

programmes.name: Master of Professional Accounting
programmes.feeBasis: Victoria University of Wellington's 2027 international fee for the whole 180-point Master of Professional Accounting (NZ$327.50 per point), taken as one year across three trimesters, plus levies.
programmes.summary: Estimated whole-programme tuition for international students: 180 points in 3 trimesters (about 1 year), including GST. Student services and hardship fees are included; insurance is extra.
programmes.notes: VUW programme page data (api/postgrad, internationalYear 2027): international fee for the full programme NZ$58,950 (= $327.50/pt x 180) with levies $1,912; the rendered page only displays the domestic figure unless a nationality is selected, so the international number was read from the page's data feed. The published levy 1,912 looks like the 2026 rate (SSF 10.44 x 180 + 32); the SSF is capped at 150 points a year in the 2026 calendar and the cap was not applied, following the page. 3 trimesters = 1 year so annual = total. History from the University Calendar Fees Schedule Part B 'MMPA courses are charged at' (international, incl. GST) x 180 points: 2026 $308.90 = 55,602.00; 2025 $291.42 = 52,455.60; 2024 $277.54 = 49,957.20. Compulsory = SSF per point x 180 + hardship fee: 2026 10.44 + $32 = 1,911.20; 2025 9.94 + $32 = 1,821.20; 2024 9.20 + $30 = 1,686.00. Assumes the 2024 and 2025 MPA was also 180 points.
